column1: # POI files as the builder's encoder writes them (builder/src/poi_files.h): what the case
# covers, the logical records (36-byte PoiRecords, types.h) and the logical vertex stream
# they point into as hex (- for no bytes, * for a stream not listed: the files' decode), and
# poi_records.bin and poi_vertices.bin as hex. The builder's tests encode the logical set to
# the files and decode them back; the server's transport must give the files back byte for
a polygon of each encoding, open and closed
